title: GTA 6 Trophies: How Hard Is the Platinum? (55 Trophies, 100%)
h1: GTA 6 trophies: how hard is the Platinum?
desc: GTA 6 has 55 trophies and the Platinum, 'Vice Got a Price!', needs 100% completion: guides say 100 to 200 hours. Who got it first, and what turns trophies off. No story spoilers.
lede: Short answer: GTA 6 has 55 trophies on PS5 and the Platinum, "Vice Got a Price!", unlocks only when you have every other one, which includes 100% completion. Trophy guides put that at roughly 100 to 200 hours. No story spoilers below.
sections: How long does the Platinum take?
Guides estimate 100 to 200 hours (KeenGamer, Notebookcheck), far more than the story alone (how long to beat GTA 6). The 100% checklist is what adds most of the time.

In launch week, the fan trophy tracker PSNProfiles listed a PS5 player called Danpool85 as the first to earn GTA 6's Platinum (GamingBible, TheGamer, Tech4Gamers). PSNProfiles isn't run by PlayStation, and Rockstar and Sony haven't confirmed a world first.
Cheats. They unlock after you finish the story, and they turn off saving and trophies for that session. If you're going for the Platinum, keep cheats for a separate session. The verified cheat list.
A launch-week Platinum on a 100-200 hour list is a sprint nobody else needs to run. If you're going for it, the checklist rewards slow, steady play more than marathons.
note: Trophy counts and times come from trophy guides and outlet reports; Rockstar hasn't published official completion times. Checked November 24, 2026.
faq: How many trophies does GTA 6 have?
55 on PS5, including the Platinum, 'Vice Got a Price!'.
How long does the GTA 6 Platinum take?
Trophy guides estimate about 100 to 200 hours, because it needs 100% completion.
Do cheats disable trophies in GTA 6?
Yes, for that session: cheats turn off saving and trophies while they're active.
